Flow.description: This Flow has been created to standardise the Opportunity Name by taking values from the Opportunity, Opportunity Line etc.

formulas.name: OpportunityName_Amendment
formulas.expression: LEFT({!GetOneOppProduct.Product_Name__c} & " | " & TEXT({!$Record.Type}) & " | " & TEXT({!GetOneOppProduct.Effective_Subscription_Term__c}) & " Months | " & TEXT({!GetOneOppProduct.SBQQ__QuoteLine__r.SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c}) & " Users | "& TEXT({!$Record.CurrencyIsoCode}) & " | " & TEXT({!$Record.Amount}) & " | " & {!$Record.Account.Name} & " | " & {!$Record.Primary_Contact__r.FirstName} & " " & {!$Record.Primary_Contact__r.LastName},120)

formulas.name: OpportunityName_ILO_NB_Multi_Line
